text: [Music] Way out West in the Texas Sun

Bring the pain

Go on, Saint Billy, do your thing
Go on, Saint Bill, go and bring the pain.
High noon and high eyed on the trail outside a saloon, so pale and frail.
A preacher man, he spoke so bold, Town folks gather round for the stories
He told him then
Coulda heard a pin drop

Repent and stop and turn to Jesus
King of kings
Bring your filth, he'll make y'all clean
Slowly the crowd broke up
But one stood shook all
trembling and stuff

And thus the New West was won.
